originalInput.name: surfaces

currentInput.name: menus

originalInput.name: per-document-state
originalInput.covers: Each document has its own shell; the unaddressed capability follows the active document; closing a document drops its slice, and reopening it starts fresh.

currentInput.name: per-document-state

originalInput.name: props-close-all-and-snapshots
originalInput.covers: updateSurfaceProps replaces props without reopening (and ignores an unknown id); closeAll closes every surface and keeps them; getSnapshot is the state; applySnapshot replaces surfaces and menus wholesale, dropping ones it does not name.

currentInput.name: props-close-all-and-snapshots
currentInput.covers: updateSurfaceProps replaces props without reopening (and ignores an unknown id); closeAll closes every surface and keeps them; getSnapshot omits focus requests; applySnapshot replaces surfaces and menus wholesale, dropping ones it does not name.

originalInput.name: events
originalInput.covers: Every write is diffed: onSurfaceOpened and onSurfaceClosed fire per surface whose open flag changed, with its props after the change (an exclusive sibling closing included, and a surface a snapshot drops closing with no props); onMenuOpened and onMenuClosed fire per menu, closes first. A write that changes nothing fires nothing, and after unsubscribing nothing fires.

currentInput.name: events
currentInput.covers: Every write is diffed: onSurfaceOpened and onSurfaceClosed fire per surface whose open flag changed, with props when opened and id only when closed (including exclusive siblings and surfaces a snapshot drops); onMenuOpened and onMenuClosed fire per menu, closes first. A write that changes nothing fires nothing, and after unsubscribing nothing fires.
